summary: Identified DRY violation: _build_graph_for_run interrupt_before branch duplicated ~35 lines of build_graph(). Fixed by adding interrupt_before: list[str] | None = None kw-only parameter to build_graph(), removing the duplicate block in cli.py.

comments.note: _build_graph_for_run() in cli.py duplicated the entire graph-building block (~35 lines) from graph.py for interrupt_before support. Resolved by adding interrupt_before kw-only parameter to build_graph() and reducing the non-dry-run branch to a single delegation call. 147/147 still pass.

asyncio.to_thread(graph.invoke, ...) used instead of graph.ainvoke() in cli._run(). This is functionally correct (avoids blocking the event loop) but graph.ainvoke() is the idiomatic async LangGraph API. Low risk since toolkit lifecycle already runs on an event loop, but worth revisiting if async streaming is added later.

datetime import inside _make_dryrun_node closure body (inside _stub). Negligible cost but module-level import is idiomatic. Not changed since it avoids polluting module namespace for a rarely-called helper.
